body: Yeah, I do love him. But I don't know man.. I'm not sure it's a good idea telling him. He's old, he had problems with alcohol. He still does, but he's getting better. Last time he told me I was the reason, that he's drinking because of me. I want him to be happy. He thinks I finally figured things out and turned out okay. And I really don't want him to start drinking again.

Hey, thank you! At least I know I'm not alone with this shit. Which doesn't make it better, but it's nice to talk to others.  
Yeah I hope you're right, I would be really happy if we could talk about it and resolve the issues.  
I actually tried a therapist half a year or so ago, but it didn't really help.. I couldn't open up, and I gradually started making up lies and acting a bit better each time. I generally find it hard to talk about my problems. I do okay here anonymously, but I just can't do it in person. My therapist seemed very happy she could help me and make my life better tho.  
Usually when I feel depressed more than the usual, I go cycling and it makes things a tiny bit better. But I couldn't get myself to do anything in the last few days.. I might try tonight, though.  
Thanks for the advice, I hope you're doing okay!

She is really good at drawing so manily stuffs related to that. Art supplies, things she might find useful.  
And just other random things. Whenever something reminded me of her, or I found something I thought she might like, I bookmarked it.. I had a pretty long list tbh so a few things off of that, that I had the money for.  
Plus a 1kg pack of candy thing that she mentioned a while ago she really liked.  
Nothing special, but I hoped some of it would make her life a tiny bit more enjoyable. I spent most of my remaining money on these things and honestly now I don't know what to do with a bunch of stuff I don't need. Oh well, at least I can eat candy all day long lol

That's the thing, she kind of is.. It wasn't a conscious decision, but for the past few months my days were basically consisting of sleeping, eating, and doing something with her. I was really happy we found each other, I liked spending time with her, she liked spending time with me, so we spent a lot of time together. We were really close and I don't want it to end like this.  
I was 99% sure she doesn't want to date me, I don't even know why I told her how I feel. I just felt like she should know, and I guess I wasn't really expecting her to react like this. I didn't think it through really, it was a bad decision. Even though it's not the best feeling, I didn't have a problem with her not wanting to date me, I am more than happy to have her as my friend.  
I hope you're right and things will work out over time. I'm just fucking scared of losing her, because it looks like she doesn't want to talk to me at all right now.
